entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane devastated by the Eldrazi, whose adventurers, land elementals and angels now mobilize against them.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: One of three Eldrazi titans; the memory of her silhouette became the merfolk deity Emeria.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Eldrazi titan; legends of him became the merfolk deity Ula.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: Eldrazi titan; legends of him became the merfolk deity Cosi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: World-devouring abominations imprisoned in the hedron prison, now risen again on Zendikar.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: Merfolk 'deity' conceptualized as a great angelic being, in truth a distorted memory of Emrakul.

entities.name: Ula
entities.description: Merfolk 'deity' that was a mask over Ulamog.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: Merfolk 'deity' that was a mask over Kozilek.

entities.name: Angels of Zendikar
entities.description: Beings created from pure white mana who resisted the Eldrazi and bear shackling halos worn down over their eyes.

entities.name: Iona
entities.description: Great archangel who still defends Zendikar from the Eldrazi; her epithet ties her to Emrakul.

entities.name: Linvala
entities.description: Angel of the new generation of freed angels whose gift is silence against the powers of evil.

entities.name: Hedron prison
entities.description: Magical prison that lulled the Eldrazi into torpor and is now loosening.

entities.name: Vampires of Zendikar
entities.description: Race the Eldrazi turned into a kind of slave race.

events.summary: The Eldrazi are lured to Zendikar and lulled into torpor by the hedron prison; centuries later they rise again and obliterate the land and the living.
events.quote: But when the abominations rose again several centuries later, Zendikar was unprepared for their assault

events.summary: Angels try to resist the Eldrazi but their resistance is cut through.
events.quote: Archangels drew their swords and stood between the Eldrazi and the land of Zendikar

events.summary: The Eldrazi leave halos on the angels worn down over their eyes, blinding them and keeping them from interfering.
events.quote: Each angel's halo is worn down over her eyes, symbolizing her mystical blindness to the Eldrazi's atrocities

events.summary: Zendikar's people mistake the halos for impartiality, and the angelic Emeria is conceptualized from the silhouette of Emrakul.
events.quote: And the terrible silhouette of Emrakul against the sky became Emeria, a vision of salvation on white-feathered wings.

events.summary: Iona and a few greater archangels keep their sight and fight the Eldrazi.
events.quote: To this day Iona fights to defend Zendikar from the Eldrazi forces that would devour it

events.summary: The halos of oppression have shattered, heralding a new generation of freed angels such as Linvala.
events.quote: It may be in the spirit of that defiance that the halos of oppression have shattered.

relations.quote: To this day Iona fights to defend Zendikar from the Eldrazi forces that would devour it

relations.note: The Eldrazi disabled the angels with halos.
relations.quote: But the Eldrazi still left their mark, and the angels have borne the scars for millennia.

relations.note: Not killed; the Eldrazi enslaved vampires.
relations.quote: They failed, too, to turn the angels into a kind of slave race, as they did with the vampires

relations.note: Emeria was a distorted legend of Emrakul.
relations.quote: And the terrible silhouette of Emrakul against the sky became Emeria

relations.note: One of the new generation of freed angels.
relations.quote: It is one of this new generation who I reveal today.
